snippet.title: Saint of Chains – Official Reveal Trailer | Retro Psychological Survival Horror FPS
snippet.description:
💀 Saint of Chains is a retro psychological survival horror FPS from the creators of Mirror Forge and Chasmal Fear.

Explore decaying, symbolic environments. Fight with scarce melee and ranged weapons. Solve sanity-bending puzzles. Uncover a truth more terrifying than the monsters themselves.

Inspired by Silent Hill 2 & 3, Condemned: Criminal Origins, Cry of Fear, and Lost in Vivo, Saint of Chains brings back the haunting feel of early 2000s horror — rebuilt for modern players.

🕯️ Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4079340/Saint_of_Chains/

📦 Press Kit (HD Trailer, Screens, Logos):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PwA5mlwhtsgXyBQdSQndiHk2GDdxjBzq?usp=sharing

👁️ Developed by MystiveDev
From the makers of Mirror Forge (DreadXP) and Chasmal Fear (Wandering Wizard / Snail Games USA)
